C I R C U L A R
In accordance with the Special Ordinance OS-1, and further to Circular No. GU/ Academic-
PG/Circular/2020/488 dated 05-05-2020; the University has decided to extend the second Term
for the academic year 2019-20 to 14th August 2020.
The University has further decided not to hold Semester End Assessment (SEA) for the
lower Semester students of all PG Programmes of General Education offered at the University
campus and at the Affiliated Colleges for the current academic year 2019-20 including the
Integrated M.B.A. (Hospitality, Travel & Tourism) Programme offered at the Goa Business School
and Integrated Master of Commerce Programme offered at S. S. Dempo College of Commerce &
Economics, Cujira, Bambolim, Goa.
All the above students shall be graded based on the marks scored by them in the Intra
Semester Assessment (ISA) during the current Semester.
Regular/Repeat Examinations of the Final Year Examination and Repeat Examinations of
lower Semesters of all PG Programmes of General Education shall be conducted in online mode
from 3rd August 2020 onwards. Detailed Guidelines for conduct of Online Examination shall be
issued subsequently.
No student shall be detained from moving to the next Semester. However, students who
fail after applying the above grading scheme shall have to pass the Examination for the course(s)
in which s/he has failed, whenever the Examination is held next.
a. Such students shall also have an opportunity to improve their grades by appearing for
the current Semester course(s) in the succeeding Semester Examinations or as per the
provisions of special Ordinance OS-1.7.
b. The performance of students appearing for improvement of grades shall not be
considered as an additional attempt.
Deans of Schools/Faculties, Vice-Deans of Schools, Heads of University Teaching
Departments and Principals of affiliated colleges offering PG Programmes of General Education
are requested to take note of the same and bring the contents of the Circular to the notice of all
concerned.
(Prof. Y. V. Reddy)
